name: Self Awareness
overview: Scripture reveals that true self-awareness begins with a humble recognition of the heart's deceitfulness and wickedness, as Jeremiah 17:9 warns that no one can fully know their own heart. The prudent seek wisdom by understanding their own ways and motives, as Proverbs 14:8 and 20:5 illustrate, drawing counsel from within with discernment. Yet, human judgment is often flawed, since every person sees their own actions as right, but the Lord alone truly examines and weighs the heart (Proverbs 21:2; Psalms 26:2). Ultimately, acknowledging God's sovereign command over all things (Lamentations 3:37) invites believers to submit their self-examination to His perfect knowledge and guidance.
